description: Attach a file to a file input (<input type=file>, often shown as a "Choose File" button) of a running profile's page by node_id, instead of clicking it - a click opens the system file picker, which cannot be controlled. Only files inside the app's uploads folder (~/.veilus/data/uploads) are allowed: pass the file name, or an absolute path inside that folder; anything else is refused. Ask the user to copy the file there first.

profile_id.description: UUID of a running profile (launch_profile first)

name: set_file
